audit.why: Kennen is a ranged laner with a stun the moment he lands a third Mark of the Storm; the existing stage sides (Kennen 1-6, even late) match that and the 50.77% win rate.
audit.corrected: Kept; ability names and the 7s Q cooldown added so the advice is actionable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike was described without the number that makes it playable.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is 120s at every rank, so a spent ult buys a full two-minute window — that is a spike for YOU, not just a spike for him.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], mid, whys[4] and wants.you[1] all now carry the flat 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stun was described as "three energy marks" without naming the mechanic or its source abilities.
audit.why: Mark of the Storm (P) stuns on the third application; Electrical Surge (W) applies one passively every few attacks and another on activation, so the stun arrives faster than a player counting only ability casts expects.
audit.corrected: early now names Mark of the Storm and Electrical Surge and states the three-mark rule.

edits.before: His Slicing Maelstrom (R) is a huge AoE stun-storm — don't dive into it. If you commit R here he simply ults you, stacks your energy marks, and stuns you out of your whole combo.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom (R) is a flat 120s at every rank — that is the clock you play to. Dive an up ult and he stacks Mark of the Storm and stuns you out of your combo; fight in the window after.

edits.before: Only all-in when his Slicing Maelstrom (R) is on cooldown
edits.after: Only all-in inside the 120s window after his R is spent

edits.before: Kennen owns the early game. He's a ranged laner who pokes with Q shuriken and W-empowered autos while you have no way to reach him, and every third instance of his lightning stacks a stun. Levels 1-2 you can only soak poke and farm carefully; don't walk up greedily or you'll eat a mark-stun and a free trade. Your passive heal barely keeps pace with his ranged chip.
edits.after: Kennen owns the early game. Thundering Shuriken (Q) is a 7s poke at rank 1 and Electrical Surge (W) adds a Mark of the Storm every few attacks — three marks and you are stunned. Levels 1-2 you can only soak and farm carefully; walk up greedily and you eat the stun plus a free trade. Your passive heal barely keeps pace with his ranged chip.

edits.before: Level 3 is your slim window — if he burns his E dash or whiffs poke, E onto him and try to land Q1-Q2-Q3 before he re-stacks marks. But from 4 onward and especially at 6 he's ahead again: Slicing Maelstrom is a long AoE stun that shuts your combo down completely, so never dive into an up ult. Play for CS, dodge shurikens, and wait for R cooldowns.
edits.after: Level 3 is your slim window — if he burns Lightning Rush (E) or whiffs the shuriken, E onto him and land Q1-Q2-Q3 before he re-stacks marks. From 4 onward, and especially at 6, he is ahead again: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s AoE storm that stacks marks and stuns you mid-combo, so never dive an up ult. Farm, dodge shurikens, count his R.

edits.before: Level 6 Slicing Maelstrom is an AoE stun that shuts your dive down.
edits.after: Level 6 Slicing Maelstrom, a flat 120s AoE stun, shuts your dive.
